Source: The neonate’s prenatal course was unremarkable, and his mother has a medical history of asthma with occasional albuterol inhaler use.
His mother notices that his face, chest, and extremities turn dusky blue during nursing.
The delivery is uncomplicated and the neonate has Apgar scores of 9 and 9 at 1 and 5 minutes respectively.
When she removes him from her breast, he begins to cry and his color improves.
She also notes that he seems to be snoring loudly and breathing very quickly.
A 32-year-old G1P0 woman delivers a boy at 40 weeks and 3 days of gestation.
After 15 minutes, he attempts to nurse for the 1st time.
